{{Quote| It would make a nice hiding place.''"<br />"''Which is precisely why we are not going there.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Yeeru Chivkyrie]]|<ref name="Allegiance (novel)">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>}}
The '''catacombs''' were a place in [[Shelkonwa]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Makrin City]]. In the capital's history, they often served as a hiding place for criminals and war criminals. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] [[Yeeru Chivkyrie]] haunted this place to hide from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
